name: aurora-agent
description: The AURORA Agent in one plugin: the bioprism MCP server (260 tools) wired into every session, FIBER decision-context commands (compile / explain / compare / validate / verify), mission preflight, an ops-auditor subagent, and skills for setup, the FIBER workflow, missions, and SDK integration. Requires a built aurora-agent checkout (AURORA_AGENT_ROOT or ~/aurora-agent).
